info.title: Streamer API
info.description:
## Getting Started

API for streamer authentication, profile management, wallet, and platform account integration.

**Base URL**

| Environment | URL |
|-------------|-----|
| Staging     | https://staging.streamstack.cc |
| Production  | https://streamstack.cc |

**Prerequisites**

All requests must include:
```
Accept: application/json
```

Most endpoints require streamer authentication (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`).

**Authentication Flow**

1. Call `GET /api/v1/auth/streamer/{platform}` to get the OAuth URL
2. Redirect the user to that URL
3. After the user authenticates, the platform redirects back with a Bearer token
4. Use that Bearer token in all subsequent requests
